extension.summary: Movie and series catalog for M3U lists that keeps only what works
Catálogo de filmes e séries para listas M3U que mantém só o que funciona
extension.description: Easy Movie shows the movies of your M3U lists as a poster catalog, with genres on the left and posters on the right. Episodes are grouped into series automatically, with seasons, episodes and a Continue button for the next episode. Watched movies and episodes are marked, and a Continue watching group resumes them where you stopped. Open a movie to see its details and play it, add it to your favorites, or remove it. Add lists from a web address, a file, or the M3U files of a GitHub repository, all from one manager window and without extra configuration. When a movie fails to play, Easy Movie offers to remove it, so your lists keep only working movies. Check a whole genre at once, restore removed movies at any time, and export a clean M3U file. With an empty library, selecting Movies or TV shows in Kodi's main menu opens Easy Movie. You can also add folders with your own video files, with posters and details from Cinemeta, and the groups also show the movies and series of the Cinemeta catalog and of Stremio addons, which open with a green check when they are downloaded. Movies play with controls in the style of streaming apps, with 10 second skips, subtitles and audio tracks, and subtitles from OpenSubtitles turn on automatically in your language.

O Easy Movie mostra os filmes das suas listas M3U como um catálogo de pôsteres, com os gêneros à esquerda e os pôsteres à direita. Os episódios são agrupados em séries automaticamente, com temporadas, episódios e um botão Continuar para o próximo episódio. Filmes e episódios assistidos ficam marcados, e o grupo Continuar assistindo retoma de onde você parou. Abra um filme para ver os detalhes e assistir, adicionar aos favoritos ou remover. Adicione listas por endereço web, por arquivo ou a partir dos arquivos M3U de um repositório do GitHub, tudo numa única janela de gerenciamento e sem configurações extras. Quando um filme falha ao abrir, o Easy Movie oferece removê-lo, para que suas listas fiquem só com filmes que funcionam. Verifique um gênero inteiro de uma vez, restaure filmes removidos quando quiser e exporte um arquivo M3U limpo. Com a biblioteca vazia, selecionar Filmes ou Seriados no menu principal do Kodi abre o Easy Movie. Você também pode adicionar pastas com os seus próprios vídeos, com pôsteres e detalhes do Cinemeta, e os grupos também mostram os filmes e séries do catálogo do Cinemeta e dos addons do Stremio, que abrem com um check verde quando estão baixados. Os filmes tocam com controles no estilo dos apps de streaming, com pulos de 10 segundos, legendas e faixas de áudio, e legendas do OpenSubtitles são ligadas automaticamente no seu idioma.
extension.disclaimer: Easy Movie does not provide any content. It plays the lists you add, and you are responsible for using only lists you are allowed to watch. The suggested GitHub repository lists public domain movies and is maintained by a third party.

O Easy Movie não fornece nenhum conteúdo. Ele reproduz as listas que você adiciona, e você é responsável por usar apenas listas que tem permissão para assistir. O repositório do GitHub sugerido reúne filmes em domínio público e é mantido por terceiros.
extension.news: 1.7.0 - The catalog joins the main screen: after the groups of your lists come the popular, featured and new movies and series of Cinemeta, the catalogs of the addons and the genres, with movies and series together. My list joins Favorites, and the search finds titles in the lists and in Cinemeta. The toolbar has Search, Check movies, Addons, Settings and Downloads, in this order. The details of a movie or series that is downloaded show a green check, and so do the downloaded episodes. The details of a series of your lists that the catalog knows list all of its episodes, and those not in the lists open their sources. Watched movies and episodes show an eye instead of a check. The download list has a scroll bar, which shows how near its end the selection is. A series downloaded from two catalogs, which name it differently, shows as one series, and a title of the catalog that is also in your lists shows once in Favorites. 1.6.5 - Removing or pausing a download shows its own error message, and explains when the drive of the downloads is read-only. 1.6.4 - Each tab of the catalog opens on My list when it has titles, and on Popular otherwise. The details of a series in the catalog show a spinner until the first season shows, and a message when the seasons and episodes could not be loaded. 1.6.3 - The direct links of the catalog, with the play icon, can also be downloaded: OK offers Watch now or Download. The download runs in the background, continues after Easy Movie closes, and shows in Downloads with the torrents. 1.6.2 - A movie or episode downloaded from the catalog keeps its title, so it shows in its series or as its movie, with the poster of the catalog. Episodes named with EP01 or Episódio 01 are episodes of their series. 1.6.1 - The focus is steel blue with white text, as in the Monteiro skin. 1.6.0 - Online subtitles: subtitles from OpenSubtitles turn on automatically in your language when a movie has none, Brazilian Portuguese first, and more can be picked in the subtitles panel. The hash of video files finds the subtitles made for them. No account is needed. 1.5.0 - Playback controls in the style of streaming apps: play and pause between back and forward 10 seconds, Left and Right skip 10 seconds, and subtitle and audio tracks in a side panel. All movies and the genres show the newest movies first. Video folders on the device are read again each time, so finished downloads show at once, and the folder of a single movie or series is no longer a genre. The catalog keeps its selection when more titles load. 1.4.0 - Catalog: a new toolbar icon opens the movies and series of Cinemeta, the catalog of Stremio, by popularity, year and genre, with search, details, seasons and episodes, and My list. Titles in your lists can be played from it. Stremio addons can be added by their address: their catalogs are shown too, and their sources open in a side panel, where a torrent goes to Downloads, only the chosen file of a pack, and a direct link plays at once. Downloads shows the free space of the folder and when it is full. Removed movies moved to the list manager. 1.3.0 - Torrent downloads: a Downloads screen in the toolbar adds magnet links and .torrent files to a folder you choose and lists the downloads with their progress, speed and time left. Downloads resume when Kodi starts. Uses the Torrest engine, included for all platforms. 1.2.0 - Video folders: add folders with your own video files from the SD card, a USB drive or a network share, with posters and details from Cinemeta, series recognized by folder, and options to rename and delete files. 1.1.3 - Moving quickly between groups no longer shows the movies of a group you already left. Opening a movie or episode while another one plays no longer reports it as not working. 1.1.2 - Streams are checked before playing while the details window stays open, so Kodi no longer freezes on servers that do not answer. 1.1.1 - Series from lists that keep the show name in pltv-subgroup, codes such as T01|EP01, 01|EP01 and EP001, and episodes that share a code. pltv-subgroup is also used as the genre of movies. 1.1.0 - Series: episodes are grouped into series with seasons and a Continue button. Watched marks, resume, a Continue watching group, the TV shows menu, and a blue focus on posters. 1.0.0 - First release.
